name: Philly Joe Jones
description: '''Joseph Rudolph''' "'''Philly Joe'''" '''Jones''' (July 15, 1923 – August 30, 1985) was an American [[Jazz drumming|jazz drummer]]. He performed with [[Miles Davis]] and [[Bill Evans]] and was noted for being able to adjust his style of playing to allow for any group or individual's needs. The "Philly" moniker referenced his hometown of [[Philadelphia]] and originated to avoid confusion with the older drummer [[Papa Jo Jones]].
